# Calendar

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Calendar`](gmeow-Calendar.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Calendar>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/calendar`](../../slices/calendar.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A CalDAV-style collection of scheduled events — an information object that aggregates calendar members and carries a default time zone. The container, not the contents.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a named collection that aggregates events and supplies a default time zone — a CalDAV-style container reused across the scheduling layer; the container, not any one event it holds.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a single event (use [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md)) or a recurrence generator (use [`gmeow:EventSchedule`](gmeow-EventSchedule.md)); the calendar holds members, it does not generate or place them.

### How to use

- Aggregate events with [`gmeow:calendarMember`](../properties/gmeow-calendarMember.md) and set one [`gmeow:calendarTimeZone`](../properties/gmeow-calendarTimeZone.md) as the default; place an event's own offset on [`gmeow:eventTimeZone`](../properties/gmeow-eventTimeZone.md) when it differs from the calendar default.

### Examples

- ex:workCal a [`gmeow:Calendar`](gmeow-Calendar.md); [`gmeow:calendarTimeZone`](../properties/gmeow-calendarTimeZone.md) ex:torontoZone; [`gmeow:calendarMember`](../properties/gmeow-calendarMember.md) ex:standupEvent.
